note: Rejudged 2026-10-31 by an auditor who authored none of the change. The only change to test/plugin/dynamic-peer-gets-group-role-capability.ci since the last stamp is cabb706c11 moving the policy block from inside bgp {} to the top-level policy root, the same lines re-indented; every action, expect, reject and option line is byte-identical, so the carriers drive the same inputs and assert the same outcomes. Verdict unchanged. RFC 9234 Section 4.1: "An eBGP speaker MUST NOT advertise multiple versions of the BGP Role Capability." The single-polarity annotation remains justified: config.go::parseRoleContainer reads one scalar import role and extractRoleCapabilities emits one declaration per selected peer; reactor/peer.go::getPluginCapabilities consumes those declarations for its selector set. TestExtractRoleCapabilities_ParseBGPConfig requires exactly one capability and one peer for every configured role. dynamic-peer-gets-group-role-capability.ci asserts the whole OPEN with exactly one 090101 TLV, including all enclosing lengths; duplicate emission cannot hide behind a substring assertion. No fabricated negative configuration is required. Rejudged independently against RFC source and every tagged carrier on 2026-10-22. Functional judgments use the corresponding test/draft/plugin files, not the unpromoted old-syntax live files. Their inactive NO-TRANSIT import/export policies explicitly end in accept; reactor runEgressPolicyChain applies that final only after mandatory in-process OTC, and OPEN validation is independent. This is a source judgment, not a new runtime or discrimination result; parent owns promotion and native freshness before stamping.
